ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_VAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_VAL(V_PRINT BOOLEAN) IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100); 
 V_COUNT NUMBER(10);
 G_START_DT DATE;
 G_END_DT DATE;
 Ret NUMBER;

BEGIN
SELECT
COUNT(MHDR.MSG_ID)
INTO
V_COUNT
FROM
MSG_HDRS MHDR
WHERE
MHDR.MSG_DIRECTION=1
AND
(
 (
 :P_DOC_TYPE = 'MAF' 
 AND VSSLMFST_PORT_CD = :P_PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE= :MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = :MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT = :MFST_DT
 )
OR
(
 :P_DOC_TYPE = 'DEO' 
 AND PORT_CD =:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD 
 AND SHPG_AGNT_NBR = :SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND DO_NBR = :DO_NBR 
 AND DO_ISS_DT = :DO_ISS_DT
)
OR
(
 :P_DOC_TYPE = 'DEC'
 AND
 PORT_CD =:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD 
 AND
 DCLTN_ISN =:DCLTN_ISN
)
OR
(
 :P_DOC_TYPE = 'SDC'
 AND
 PORT_CD =:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD 
 AND
 STATS_ISN =:DCLTN_ISN
)
OR
(
 :P_DOC_TYPE IS NULL
)

)

;

IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 

 IF V_PRINT = TRUE THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER'); 
 ELSE
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'SCREEN'); 
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 END IF;
 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES'); 
 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD );
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:parameter.P_MODULE_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:REPORT_NO);
 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MFST_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:MFST_TYPE);

ProgramUnit.Name: DISP_FIELDS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE DISP_FIELDS(V_CLR BOOLEAN) IS
cur_itm VARCHAR2(80);
cur_itm_FULL VARCHAR2(80);
cur_block VARCHAR2(80):=:System.Cursor_Block;
V_HINT_TXT VARCHAR2(2000);
BEGIN
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
cur_itm:=Get_Block_Property(cur_block,FIRST_ITEM );

WHILE(cur_itm IS NOT NULL ) LOOP
cur_itm_FULL :=cur_block||'.'||cur_itm;

 IF :P_DOC_TYPE IN ('DEC','SDC') AND CUR_ITM IN('DCLTN_TYPE_NAME','DCLTN_NBR',
 'DCLTN_DT2','DCLTN_DT') THEN
 SHOW_ITEM(TRUE,cur_itm_FULL);
 ELSIF :P_DOC_TYPE ='DEO' AND CUR_ITM IN('DO_ISS_DT','DO_NBR','SHPG_AGNT_NBR',
 'SHPNG_AGNT_NAME','SHP_AGNT_B','DO_B') THEN
 SHOW_ITEM(TRUE,cur_itm_FULL);
 ELSIF :P_DOC_TYPE = 'MAF' AND CUR_ITM IN('MFST_DT','MFST_NBR','MFST_TYPE',
 'VSSLMFST_PORT_CD','B_PORT','PORT_NAME','M_B') THEN
 SHOW_ITEM(TRUE,cur_itm_FULL);
 ELSIF CUR_ITM IN('DCLTN_TYPE_NAME','DCLTN_NBR','DCLTN_DT2','DCLTN_DT',
 'DO_ISS_DT','DO_NBR','SHPG_AGNT_NBR','SHPNG_AGNT_NAME',
 'MFST_DT','MFST_NBR','MFST_TYPE','SHP_AGNT_B','M_B','DO_B') THEN
 SHOW_ITEM(FALSE,cur_itm_FULL);
 END IF;
------------------------
IF CUR_ITM IN('DCLTN_TYPE_NAME','PORT_NAME','SHPNG_AGNT_NAME') THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_TYPE_NAME',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_TYPE_NAME',REQUIRED,PROPERTY_FALSE);

END IF;
-----------------------
 cur_itm := Get_Item_Property(cur_itm_FULL,NEXTITEM);
END LOOP;
---------------------------------------CLEAR FIELDS------------------------------------------
IF V_CLR = TRUE THEN
 :DCLTN_TYPE_NAME :=NULL;
 :DCLTN_NBR :=NULL;
 :DCLTN_ISN :=NULL;
 :DCLTN_TYPE_CD :=NULL;
 :DCLTN_DT :=NULL;
 :MFST_DT :=NULL;
 :MFST_NBR :=NULL;
 :MFST_TYPE :=NULL;
 --:VSSLMFST_PORT_CD :=NULL;
 :DO_ISS_DT :=NULL;
 :DO_NBR :=NULL;
 :SHPG_AGNT_NBR :=NULL;
 :SHPNG_AGNT_NAME :=NULL;
END IF;


END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VLIDATE_DCLTN
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE vlidate_dcltn (p_dcltn_nbr NUMBER, p_dcltn_dt DATE)
IS
BEGIN
 IF p_dcltn_nbr IS NOT NULL AND p_dcltn_dt IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 IF :p_doc_type = 'DEC'
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT dcltn_isn, dcltn_type_cd, type_name
 INTO :dcltn_isn, :dcltn_type_cd, :dcltn_type_name
 FROM declarations, dcltn_types
 WHERE dcltn_nbr = :dcltn_nbr
 AND dcltn_dt = :dcltn_dt
 AND type_id = declarations.dcltn_type_cd
 AND (port_cd, dcltn_isn) IN (
 SELECT msg_hdrs.port_cd,
 msg_hdrs.dcltn_isn
 FROM msg_hdrs
 WHERE doc_type = 'DEC' AND PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD );
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 :dcltn_isn := NULL;
 :dcltn_type_cd := NULL;
 :dcltn_type_name := NULL;
 :dcltn_nbr := NULL;
 :dcltn_dt := NULL;
 str.dispalert ('البيان المدخل غير صحيح', 'ERROR');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END;
 ELSIF :p_doc_type = 'SDC'
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT stats_isn, stats_type_cd, rv_meaning
 INTO :dcltn_isn, :dcltn_type_cd, :dcltn_type_name
 FROM stats_dcltns, cg_ref_codes
 WHERE stats_nbr = :dcltn_nbr
 AND stats_dcltns.PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD 
 AND stats_dt = :dcltn_dt
 AND rv_domain = 'STATS_TYPE'
 AND rv_low_value = stats_dcltns.stats_type_cd;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 :dcltn_isn := NULL;
 :dcltn_type_cd := NULL;
 :dcltn_type_name := NULL;
 :dcltn_nbr := NULL;
 :dcltn_dt := NULL;
 str.dispalert ('البيان المدخل غير صحيح', 'ERROR');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END;
 ELSE
 :dcltn_isn := NULL;
 :dcltn_type_cd := NULL;
 :dcltn_type_name := NULL;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;
